USYD_MTeachSecondary_NESA.value: USyd Master of Teaching (Secondary) is NESA-accredited; graduates can be accredited as teachers (pending LANTITE).

wwccNSW_visaHolders.value: NSW Working With Children Check accepts an Australian visa (with foreign passport) as commencement-of-identity document, so visa holders can apply.
wwccNSW_visaHolders.quote: Australian Visa current at the time of entry to Australia as a resident or tourist* Note: this must be supported by a foreign passport, which is needed for verification

wwccVIC_visaHolders.value: Victorian WWC Check accepts a foreign passport linked to a valid Australian visa (Group B), plus one Group A document (driver licence, learner permit or Medicare card); otherwise verify in person at Australia Post. Page updated 5 October 2026.
wwccVIC_visaHolders.quote: Foreign passport linked to a valid Australian visa

NESA_graduateProvisional.value: A graduate of a teaching degree in Australia may be eligible for NESA Provisional accreditation; no citizenship condition stated.
NESA_graduateProvisional.quote: I’ve graduated from a teaching degree in Australia You may be eligible for Provisional accreditation.

NSWDoE_internationalStudents.value: International students/graduates can get casual and temporary approval to teach in NSW public schools with a visa that allows work; full approval and permanent employment require citizenship or permanent residency.
NSWDoE_internationalStudents.quote: Yes, you can apply for casual and temporary teaching approval provided you hold a valid visa for employment in Australia. You will not be eligible for full approval to teach or permanent employment if you do not hold Australian citizenship or permanent residency

VIT_provisional.value: VIT provisional registration requires a completed approved qualification (ITE program for teachers, EC program for early childhood teachers); no citizenship condition stated. Granted for 2 years.
VIT_provisional.quote: Teachers who wish to apply for provisional registration must have completed an approved qualification – an ITE program for teachers or an EC program for early childhood teachers.
